claims: "No Kings" is a largely 2025 American political protest movement.
"No Kings" is used to mobilize large-scale, nationwide protests.
Large-scale, nationwide protests are often termed "No Kings Day".
"No Kings" is used as a rallying cry.
"No Kings" is used in journalism to describe the pro-democracy movement.
The movement is organized by the No Kings Coalition.
The movement is organized by the 50501 Movement.
The movement grew to feature millions of participants.
